events.label: Shift hours to Monday
events.summary: Shift hours to Monday: 4.0 ± 0.0 vs 2.6 ± 1.0 for current practice (visits/week by residents who can't make current hours). E4 has the highest visits/week among residents who can’t make current hours at 4.0 ± 0.0, beating current practice at 2.6 ± 1.0 and also outperforming E1 at 3.6 ± 0.6 and E5 at 3.1 ± 1.0. Even though it uses 102 staff h/wk, it is the strongest option on the target metric and also leads the held-out tests in two scenarios (9.625 in A, 7.5 in B).
events.assumptions: The result depends on the synthetic resident schedules, arrival rates, and word-of-mouth rates used in the model defaults; no local source here constrains those inputs. The held-out scenarios are also synthetic test cases, not observed town data.
events.pilot: Run a 6–8 week pilot with E4 hours on a limited basis, and measure weekly visits by residents who previously could not make current hours, total staff hours used, and no-show/turnaway counts. Compare against the same weeks last year or a nearby branch using current practice hours.
